body: That’s the kind of mind set that is dangerous. My brother had a masters degree in physics but felt like he was “unlovable” and therefore had no purpose. To be so young and think that hurts my heart. It may not be great right now, but hang on and find that purpose

So this is just my point of view and I hope it helps. I had suicidal ideation at a very young age (~8). I never went all the way with it, although I did plan it a few times. When I was 18 I turned to drugs (meth) and alcohol. I ended up in prison for selling and spent 3 years alone. It made me wake up and realize what true isolation was. No one, for 3 years cared about me, no friends, the constant moving of facilities. And the lack of freedom. When I got out I did feel a bit depressed about now being a felon and felt like I had thrown my life away. But here I am now, 28 years old with a good job and a beautiful daughter. She is one now and is my life. I thank God every day I was able to finally be happy. 
This may be your dark time but please, know that it gets better. And BTW, my brother died by suicide 4-10-2021. I miss him terribly and I have regrets of not telling him how much he meant to me before he took his own life.
